title: Limit a Deployment to a Canary
objectives: Limit a Deployment to a Canary
Verify the result through independent inspection and explain the observed state.

tasks.instruction: Open Terminal. Run ssh svc_ansible@ansible01, then cd ~/splunk-automation. Commands run inside the virtual environment.
Run ansible all --list-hosts --limit idx01, then ansible all -m ping --limit idx01. Verify that only the canary is targeted.

hints: Inspect the affected component or inventory file first.
Use the documented command output to answer the evidence questions.
